watch.summary: A Rocket League player shouts in utter disbelief when an opponent somehow speeds past him to score a goal.

beats.what: Creator complains about his opponent being annoying.
Creator takes a shot on goal and yells for it to go in.
Opponent catches up unexpectedly fast and scores.
Creator explodes in outrage and disbelief.
Creator gesticulates wildly, arguing they were moving at the same speed.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: it's no freaking way! We're moving at the same speed!
watch.why: The sudden shift from confident excitement to high-energy outrage and laughter makes the clip funny to anyone. His expressive body language and genuine disbelief sell the comedic surprise.
